title: Build the updated Meadow from the prototype

completion_criteria.text: An interphase prototype spec for the Meadow, with its items file, is approved by the owner
completion_criteria.check: check_spec.py and check_items.py report no errors on docs/specs/meadow.md and docs/specs/meadow.items.json, and the owner's approval is recorded in docs/specs/meadow.decisions.md

completion_criteria.text: The approved Steps are dispatched with mitosis and ship as draft pull requests, none merged
completion_criteria.check: the mitosis run ends with every MSP shipped as a draft PR and its acceptance gate reporting no inert tests

completion_criteria.text: A meadow with 366 flowers stays smooth on Android and macOS without changing its look or feel
completion_criteria.check: unsettled: the measurable frame-time target and how it is measured are decided in the spec interview

spine.active_goal: Bring the prototype's Meadow (renamed from Garden) into the live Flutter app: per-user, per-year randomized meadow generation, the year / day-by-day / year-so-far UI, viewing past years, and hover or select on a flower showing its planted date, while keeping the current aesthetic and making it smooth with up to 366 flowers on macOS and Android. Spec it with the interphase prototype pathway, get approval, then dispatch with mitosis.
spine.next_step: Audit docs/prototype/project/Meadow.dc.html (the primary design per docs/prototype/README.md) and its imports, then Meadow v2, Meadow Scene and the Meadow section of Field Notes.dc.html, and map the randomization, layout and rendering logic to the live garden code under lib/features/garden.
